description: Paid ($0.02 USDC via x402 on Base or Solana): audit the open token approvals of an EVM wallet (base, ethereum, arbitrum, optimism, polygon, bsc), for example your agent's own wallet as a periodic check. Get back green/orange/red, a grade, a one-line summary and every ERC-20 allowance with its spender: flagged malicious (red), a plain wallet, on a doubt list, an unverified contract or an unlimited allowance to a spender not on the GoPlus trust list (orange), plus which ones to revoke and a revoke.cash link. NFT approvals are not covered. Same as GET /v1/approvals. The answer carries a signed receipt (EIP-191, bound to your arguments) that proves later which verdict you got.
